title: When you are ahead, look again
outcomes: Names the pattern of relaxing when ahead: taking the first gain without asking about a threat or something stronger
Runs the safety scan and the opponent's-best-reply look before a capture when ahead
Tells a capture the scan clears from one it stops, and a hidden threat from a quiet position
Writes a ten-move routine for his next game when he is ahead

steps.text: Players often relax when they are ahead, and a classic slip follows: taking the first gain on offer without asking what the opponent threatens, or whether something stronger exists. **Feeling safe is a risk.** A habit to try: when you are ahead, run the safety scan and look at the opponent's best reply before every move, for ten moves in a row.

steps.caption: Black to move and far ahead. The pawn on h5 can be taken. Run the scan first.

line.say: gxh5 takes a pawn. It looks free.
Qh7 is checkmate: the pawn that blocked the queen and bishop has gone.

claims.statement: The engine rates Black at least five pawns ahead.
Rae8 and Rfe8 are the engine's top moves.

steps.text: **When the scan fits.** Use it when you are ahead and tempted to relax or to grab. It costs seconds, and it does not mean refusing every gain: when the scan finds nothing, take what is offered. It adds little in a level, tense position, where you are already looking. "Ahead" is a rule of thumb: a piece or more, or a clearly better position.

steps.title: Same king, one pawn different
steps.prompt: White is far ahead in both positions, and the only difference is one pawn: h3 in the first, h2 in this one. Predict whether Qxh5 wins a pawn here, then check. A level position, where nobody is ahead, comes up in the exercises after this.

steps.text: **What the app does for you now, and when it stops.** The app cannot watch a game while you play, so it cannot tell when you are ahead: you set the flag, say so to yourself and run the scan. The first exercises came with hints; the silent ones come with none. Mark each scanned move with an S in your own notes, not on a tournament score sheet.

steps.prompt: Write the routine for the next game in which you are ahead. Ten scanned moves in a row is a first guess for the habit.

fields.label: I will call myself "ahead" when:
options: I am a piece or more up
I am a pawn or more up
my analysis says I am clearly better
